FIELDS.NAME: Tech Solutions Group
FIELDS.MAILING ADDRESS: 123 Technology Drive, Suite 100, Innovation City, CA 94016-1234
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Tech Solutions Group specializes in providing comprehensive IT and technology services to small and medium-sized enterprises. Our core operations encompass a range of offerings, including remote IT support, cybersecurity assessments, software development, and managed service solutions. We prioritize best practices in data protection and compliance, ensuring that our clients meet industry standards such as GDPR and CCPA. Our team is dedicated to delivering reliable services from secure environments, minimizing on-site exposure risks, and enhancing our clients' technological capabilities. With a strong focus on customer support and tailored solutions, we strive to empower businesses through innovative technology.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On May 10, 2023, we experienced a data breach due to unauthorized access to our client databases, resulting in an estimated loss of $10,000. The incident was promptly reported, and we are currently engaged with cybersecurity experts to remediate and enhance our security protocols. As of now, the status is active. Additionally, on July 15, 2023, a critical software failure led to downtime for two client operations, causing a loss of approximately $5,000. This incident has been resolved, and measures have been implemented to prevent future occurrences.
